names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 noiembrie, «Sfântul Proroc Avdie».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Νοεμβρίου, «Προφήτης Αβδιού», with the rank word left off. The same page also prints the variant «Οβδιού», which is not recorded as a separate form.

Read off his own name page, 9, which heads him «Авдий, пророк, из 12 малых пророков» — everything beside the forename is the rank `prophet` this folder already carries and the enumeration of the Twelve, so the bare form is the whole of what the calendar gives. The day line for him is broken markup and carries no readable name. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports **one folder already holding this exact form**, `abda-bishop-of-persia`, which stores both «Авдий» and «Авид» for a bishop in Persia of the fifth century kept on 5 сентября ст. ст. A prophet of the ninth century before Christ and a Persian bishop of the fifth after it; two men, one string, and no fuller form on either page to tell them apart by.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 ноября ст. ст. — «Прор. Авдия (из 12-ти) (IX до Р.Х.).»
doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 19 noiembrie — «Sfântul Proroc Avdie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Νοεμβρίου — «Προφήτης Αβδιού»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2902/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own minor prophet: the page spells him «Αβδιού (ή Οβδιού)», glosses the name as «δούλος Κυρίου», quotes his own book at Οβδιού α΄ 3-4, and makes him a disciple of the prophet Elijah, which is the relation the folder already records. No `dates` are proposed: the page prints two readings — «έζησε περί το 800 π.Χ., (κατ' άλλη εκδοχή στο δεύτερο μισό του 6ου αιώνα π.Χ.)» — and which of the two the corpus should hold is a question for an author, not a reader. The hymn taken is the page's «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα)», which names him and gives both its ἦχος and its model; the page's first apolytikion, «Τοῦ Προφήτου σου Ἀβδιού τὴν μνήμην», is the common of a prophet with his name set in it and carries a tone but no model, and the Κάθισμα is neither a troparion nor a kontakion, so neither is drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Pomenind prăznuirea prorocului tău Avdie, Doamne, printr-însul Te rugăm: izbăveşte sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfântului Proroc Avdie», glas 2, the common of a prophet with his name in it

english.text: As we keep the feast of Thy prophet Obadiah, O Lord, through him we entreat Thee: deliver our souls.

hymns.text: Ὥσπερ θεράπων φερωνύμως τοῦ Λόγου, τοῦ ὑπὲρ ἔννοιαν φωτὸς ἠξιώθης, καὶ προφητείας ἔλλαμψιν ἐδέξω σοφὲ δόξαν γὰρ τὴν ἄυλον, καθαρῶς ἐποπτεύων, ὄργανον θεόπνευστον, Ὀβδιοὺ ἀνεδείχθης, προμελωδοῦν ἐν κόσμῳ μυστικῶς, τῶν ἐσομένων, Προφῆτα τὴν ἔκβασιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ — on the page of «Προφήτης Αβδιού». It names him, in the page's variant spelling «Ὀβδιού», and no other saint.

english.text: As a servant of the Word, true to your own name, you were counted worthy of light beyond understanding and received the shining of prophecy, O wise one. For beholding purely the glory that has no matter, you were shown to be a God-breathed instrument, Obadiah, singing out beforehand in the world, mystically, the outcome of things to come, O Prophet.

floruit.note: This folder held no date at all. days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 19 ноября ст. ст. with «(IX до Р.Х.)» and its life page opens «Святой пророк Авдий (из 12-ти, IX век до Рождества Христова)». The century is kept as the interval; the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah the page names are not turned into years of their own.
